n: Florida Poly Counting M&Ms OpenCV lesson
t: A computer vision lesson where students write Python to count M&Ms by color.
steps: Find the Counting M&Ms lesson plan from Florida Polytechnic University.
Download the lesson plan and notebooks.
Prepare a webcam or recorded video of M&Ms.
Open the first notebook in Google Colab and run it yourself.
Check the answer key against your results.
Share the vocabulary sheet before the lesson.
